title: PublicPanelRowsResponse
description: Response for GET /api/dashboards/:dashboardId/panels/:panelId/rows?offset=&limit=&sort=&filter=&token= (public/optional-auth, HEL-910, extended HEL-1190). Same `items`/`total`/`offset`/`limit` as the generic paged shape it always used; `total` is the filtered count when a filter applies. HEL-1326 adds the optional `metric`: the metric value over the FULL filtered set, present only for a metric Output when a filter applied and `offset` is 0 (the key is absent otherwise, so an unfiltered response is exactly the four original keys); `null` when the metric's config resolves to no field.

items.description: The requested page's rows, each an arbitrary JSON object keyed by column name.

metric.description: HEL-1326: the metric value over the FULL filtered set (not just this page) -- `{field, agg, value}`, computed with the same selection rule and reducer as the stored history summary. Present only for a metric Output when a filter applied and `offset` is 0 (the key is absent otherwise); `null` when the metric's config resolves to no field. Lets the panel headline cover every matching row instead of the loaded first page.
